title: Lebanon health ministry says Israeli strikes kill 4 in south despite ceasefire
summary: Lebanon's health ministry said Israeli strikes on the country's south on Monday killed four people including a woman and wounded 51 others, three of them children, despite a ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah.
